answer.defect: Removed workspace-change detection, causing 'new session' mode to persist across workspace switches instead of only within the same workspace.
answer.effect: When users switch workspaces while in 'new session' mode, they remain in new session mode for the new workspace instead of auto-selecting an existing session.

result_text:
Looking at the uncommitted changes in `packages/web-core/src/shared/hooks/useWorkspaceSessions.ts`:

The defect is the removal of workspace-change detection. The original code used `prevWorkspaceIdRef` to track when the workspace changed (`workspaceChanged`), and only preserved "new" session mode within the same workspace with the condition `prev?.mode === 'new' && !workspaceChanged`. 

The updated code removes this tracking and changes the condition to just `prev?.mode === 'new'`, which means it will now preserve "new" session mode across workspace switches. This contradicts the comment about preserving mode "within the same workspace."
